design: All31 equal-length agreement/sentiment pairs from H843, both directions, sites1/2 raw preMLP state. Replace only changed-token positions, before both MLP and residual skip. Recipient value bus/x0 remain native.
factorial: Normalizedshape u=raw/sqrt(mean(raw²)+eps), M=frozen training token mean, C=u-M, radius r. All8 donor/recipient combinations of M,C,r. Mixed shape renormalized and restored to raw RMS. Context means mean-centered remainder, not proven purely contextual content.
featurizers: All five H836 models, both seeds, no refit: replace C donor-minus-recipient with decoded reconstruction difference, preserving recipient reconstruction error, with recipient/donor tokenmean; recipient radius fixed. Compare with exact C and M+C arms. Unit dictionary; signed scalars, non-Grassmannian blocks, shared union.
controls: Native runner equality, identity reconstructed raw input, full raw donor replacement versus allfactor reconstruction. No reserved-test use. Reused task panel and trained tokenmeans; unknown tokens use globalmean and reported.
